Market Impact and Regulatory Context
The SEC’s delay caused immediate market reactions, with XRP dropping 2.8% to $0.62 and Dogecoin falling 1.5% to $0.14 on March 12, 2025. Trading volumes surged, reflecting investor uncertainty. The delays align with the SEC’s cautious approach

SEC Delays XRP and Dogecoin ETF Decisions
The U.S. SEC has delayed decisions on multiple crypto ETF filings, including spot XRP and Dogecoin ETFs, pushing deadlines to June 2025. The delays affect proposals from Bitwise, Franklin Templeton, and Grayscale, among others. Industry https://t.co/KeRLnRlkLD
